help_modal.intro: This tool helps you to find the correct combination for the vault in Payday 3.
help_modal.enter_before: Enter the 2, 3 or 4 digits from the fingerprints on the vault keypad then click the
help_modal.enter_after: button to calculate the possible combinations.
help_modal.remove_before: To remove the entered digits click the
help_modal.remove_after: button. Right-click/long-press to clear all entered digits.
help_modal.theme_after: icon to toggle between light and dark mode.
help_modal.keybind_digits: Numbers or numpad - Enter digits from keyboard

install_modal.body_intro: Do you want to install this app on your device? This will allow you to launch from your home screen and use whilst offline.
install_modal.body_cancel_note: If you choose to cancel, you will not be asked again. You can still install the app manually by clicking the install icon in the address bar or under the 3 dot menu.

view_all_combos_modal.hint_tried: Left-click on a combination to mark it as tried
view_all_combos_modal.hint_correct: Right-click/long-press on a combination to mark it as correct
